# I'm AiDog

> A personal embodied AI: a constitution for a personality, curated memory for a life, and a self-developed core that answers to you alone. Permanently free for any use, local-first console, Telegram-first channels.

I'm AiDog is a single companion you run yourself — not a platform, not an assistant farm. Three constitutional facts: it is permanently free (no paid tier, no usage fee, no paid feature gate, ever), the console is local-first (state, memory and configuration stay on your own machine), and the core kernel is self-developed in-house rather than wrapped from a third party.

## Product

- Permanently free: no pricing, no paid features, no usage metering.
- Local-first console: web UI on your own machine for chat, memory, skills, cron and channel configuration.
- Constitution and curated memory: behavioural rules and long-term memory are versioned assets you control.
- Skills and automations: skill packs, scheduled tasks and Telegram-driven control.
- Bring-your-own model: model endpoints and credentials are configured by the operator.

## Interfaces

- Web console: streaming chat UI plus settings, memory, cron, skills and channel management.
- Telegram bot: first-class messaging channel with streaming replies and typing indicators.
- OpenAI-compatible API: the local console exposes `GET /v1/models` and `POST /v1/chat/completions` (streaming and non-streaming) behind a Bearer token, so OpenAI-style tooling can point at it.

## Live stats

- [Visits](https://aidog.im/api/visits): JSON counter returning `{"count": <integer>, "unit": "page views", "note": "approximate, includes crawlers and refreshes"}`. One increment per page load; approximate by design. Append `?format=text` for `text/plain` output (`visits: <integer>`). If the counter is not configured the endpoint answers `503` with an error object instead of a fabricated number.
